memo_markdown:
## Recommendation

Put next quarter's product effort on [ISS-usability], "Playback controls broken after recent updates." It ranks first with a priority score of 155358 [C11], from 68832 complaints [C7] and a mean severity of 2.257061 [C10].

## Why this issue

- It has the highest priority score of the eight issues, 155358 [C11], and a severity sum of 155358 [C9].
- Expressed cancellation intent is 5571 [C8]. That is not the largest count of the set, so this is a ranking on the overall score, not a claim of dominance on every measure.
- The evidence pack shows data-loss themes. One reviewer (review 25c2686b-9948-4e01-a006-25ae1f3cc4ca) wrote: "I lost all of my data just to find out that the problem is still not fixed." Another (review 18308b6c-2b30-4e54-a95f-2a246b49376c) wrote: "Even the playlist which I had saved for years just got vanished."
- The gap to second place is modest: 155358 [C11] versus 144846 [C17]. Treat the ordering as directional.

## Alternatives considered

- **[ISS-playback]** (rank 2): priority score 144846 [C17], with 45188 complaints [C13] and a higher mean severity of 3.205409 [C16]. It is the closest alternative and the right second bet. Sample quotes (e.g. review 0377db91-97c1-41f5-ad41-97543d5df5ac, "No songs will play, all my play list are gone") overlap with the usability theme, so some of the work may be shared.
- **[ISS-other]** (rank 3): the most complaints, 84647 [C19], but the lowest mean severity among the top four, 1.691247 [C22]. Its score is 143159 [C23]. The category is a catch-all, so it is hard to assign to one team.
- **[ISS-billing]** (rank 4): score 114549 [C29], but the highest cancellation-intent count, 8206 [C26], from 43410 complaints [C25]. If leadership weights stated cancellation intent above overall score, this is the strongest case for switching. Review 00924d14-8608-4fe2-853f-44ebbb975362 describes being charged after cancelling.
- **[ISS-access]**: mean severity is the highest, 3.897331 [C40], but only 12214 complaints [C37], so the score is 47602 [C41]. Worth a targeted fix for account recovery rather than a full quarter.

Other issues ([ISS-catalog], [ISS-downloads], [ISS-support]) score lower, at 60860 [C35], 25106 [C47] and 2240 [C53].

## Limitations

- Reviews are self-selected public app store posts, not a customer population.
- The data holds no account, plan, spend or subscription-status information. Cancellation intent is stated in text, not observed, so this memo cannot size business impact in money terms.
- Labels come from a model checked against a 50-review golden set and a verifier sample, so some misclassification is possible. The category names overlap: playlist-loss quotes appear under several issues, including [ISS-other] and [ISS-playback].
- Of 660622 source rows [C1], 660144 were completed [C2] and 478 were quarantined [C3]; pending records number 0 [C4]. Quarantined records are excluded from every count. Complaint records total 286629 [C5].
- Partial months (2022-05 and 2023-11) may skew totals.
- The priority score equals the severity sum, so volume and severity are blended and the top three are close.
